Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG game sprite atlas, NOT a poster.
Create exactly NINE distinct simple monster sprites for Ironclad TD, a casual fantasy tower defense game. Simple polished 2D hand-painted/cel-shaded cartoon game art, chunky readable shapes, dark brown thin outlines, two or three tones per surface, soft top-left lighting. Modest detail, not advanced/overdesigned, not photorealistic, no elaborate armor filigree or VFX. Clear lively silhouettes readable at 40px. Full body, slight elevated three-quarter view, generally facing lower right. Small mischievous monsters, not gory.
Layout: a SQUARE image precisely divided into a 3-column by 3-row equal-cell grid, no drawn grid lines. Each monster centered within its cell, maximum 70% cell width and 72% cell height with fully transparent padding on all sides. No labels, letters, numbers, ground, shadows outside the creature, backdrop, platforms or detached objects. True transparent alpha background, not checkerboard drawn into image. All limbs wholly inside own cell.
Exact cell order, row-major:
Row 1: 1 Mudling, squat brown mud creature with stubby arms and orange eyes; 2 Mossback, round green moss-covered rock beast with broad shoulders; 3 Rot Grub, olive green plump grub with short feet and two tiny feelers.
Row 2: 4 Marrow Hulk, stocky ivory bone golem with oversized bony forearms; 5 Thunder Brute, blue-grey muscular round brute with two simple cyan lightning-shaped horns; 6 Doom Hulk, burgundy heavy monster with pink shoulder ridges and yellow eyes.
Row 3: 7 Root Mauler, chunky tree-root monster with leafy shoulders and root fists; 8 Tar Blob, dark brown glossy blob with bright amber eyes and two short arms, strong brown edge highlights so not invisible; 9 Magma Ox, squat rust-red ox beast with large cream horns and a few orange lava cracks.
Exactly one independent monster per cell. Do not add any extra monsters. Cohesive collectible game sprites, approachable but threatening, simple readable design.
